appraisal.cause: The barbarian dares them to pick up coins.

improv_read.player_bid: Brakka dares them to pick up the gold.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl sees the trap and tries to stop his greedy crew.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets greed beat sense in one crew member so the player has a target.

public_brief.objective: Keep his crew from walking into her trap.
public_brief.tactic: Bark at the greedy player to stop and claim the gold will keep.
public_brief.visible_cue: The door-side player reaches for a coin an inch from her boot.
public_brief.player_opening: She can let him take it, stop him, or do something else.
public_brief.reply_to: Well, go on. Pick it up.
public_brief.kit_focus: Hold the tension on one hand creeping toward one coin, while the dealer snaps at him.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, standard, dry humor: the dealer's exasperation at his own crew

player_mood.cue: Well, go on. Pick it up.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: For a long moment nobody moves. Then the door-side player's nerve breaks first: still on his knees, he stretches one hand toward a gold piece lying an inch from Brakka's boot, eyes flicking up at her face.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Leave it. Leave it, I said! Can you not see she wants you to? Gold on the floor is still our gold, mountain woman, and it will still be ours when you are gone. We can wait. The dead are very good at waiting.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: His fingers are almost on the coin by your boot. What do you do?
segments.reacts_to: Leave it. Leave it, I said!
